description.en: Same as AddParty_Important_Message, but shows the "sysmes-back_party" message (a member rejoining) instead of "sysmes-add_party".
Param ID of the character to add back to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Bringing an important member back and setting their level (not found in script_clean/; invented, following the AddParty_Message family's real usage pattern)
examples.code:
// Bring an important party member back with the "J_07" jingle presentation and set their level to 20
AddParty_Important_Message_Back("para_cp0001", true, false, false, 20);

examples.case: Bringing an important member back without changing their level
examples.code:
// Bring an important party member back with the "J_07" jingle presentation, keeping their current level
AddParty_Important_Message_Back("para_cp0001", true, false, false);
